gates.name: workspace_inventory
gates.evidence: AGENTS.md, docs, scripts, .agents, .codex, .github, database, backend and frontend are present; .env presence confirmed without reading its contents.

gates.name: working_tree_preservation
gates.evidence: Pre-operation and post-operation SHA-256 manifests matched for all 557 relevant files; zero differences. Runtime caches were excluded.

gates.name: git_remote_discovery
gates.evidence: GitHub was reached with OpenSSL, but the private repository requested authentication. gh auth status reports no authenticated GitHub hosts; no SSH key is available.

gates.name: git_reconnection
gates.evidence: No .git directory was created because remote HEAD/default branch could not be verified before association. No checkout, reset, restore, clean or history rewrite was used.

gates.name: git_diff_check_and_ignore_hygiene
gates.evidence: Requires a safely reconnected Git repository. The local .gitignore contains .env, .env.*, .venv, .uv-python, .uv-cache, pytest, mypy, Ruff and __pycache__ rules, but tracked-state proof is unavailable without remote history.

gates.name: openapi_contract
gates.evidence: OpenAPI regenerated from the backend; check-openapi-contract-files.py returned OK; backend/openapi.json and contracts/openapi/baseline.json are byte-identical (SHA-256 088D081BA2CB4C4A61C425942033B661C9885739D94E0F2F9C2010A80A6A9493); Courses 422 references #/components/schemas/ErrorBody.

gates.name: oasdiff_breaking
gates.evidence: Canonical tufin/oasdiff v1.30.0 image at locked digest sha256:c1200e64fa9b2229b7aee39fe389bd5b49c7cb955923f8a6b20791a6dcf1deed returned 'No changes detected' after regeneration. Only the two OpenAPI JSON files were mounted read-only and container networking was disabled.

gates.name: github_actions
gates.evidence: Push, pull request and workflow dispatch require GitHub authentication that is not present in the environment. No run was fabricated or inferred.

residual_risks: Remote default branch, remote HEAD SHA and tracked-sensitive-file inventory remain unverified until GitHub authentication is supplied through an interactive secure login.
Quality, security and release GitHub Actions cannot be evidenced until the branch is pushed and workflows complete.
notes: MISSION 001.1 remains PENDING. OASDIFF is closed; Git reconnection and GitHub Actions are blocked by missing GitHub authentication. No secret was printed or persisted, and no destructive Git operation was executed.
